label: Brisnik ANXI4: antidepressant for anxiety with a benzodiazepine for over 4 weeks
title: Antidepressant for anxiety with a benzodiazepine for over 4 weeks
statement: Prescribed an antidepressant for anxiety - and the patient is co-prescribed benzodiazepine > 4 weeks

source.document: Brisnik V, et al. Deprescribing of antidepressants: indicators of high-risk and overprescribing. BMC Med 2024;22:193, Tables 3-4
source.citation: Brisnik V, Vukas J, Jung-Sievers C, et al. Deprescribing of antidepressants: development of indicators of high-risk and overprescribing using the RAND/UCLA Appropriateness Method. BMC Med 2024;22:193. doi:10.1186/s12916-024-03397-w
source.credit: Brisnik V, Vukas J, Jung-Sievers C, et al. Deprescribing of antidepressants: development of indicators of high-risk and overprescribing using the RAND/UCLA Appropriateness Method. BMC Med 2024;22:193. doi:10.1186/s12916-024-03397-w

plain_summary: Review the benefits and risks when a benzodiazepine has been prescribed alongside an antidepressant for anxiety for more than four weeks. Ask how often the benzodiazepine is taken.

medicine_groups.name: Antidepressants
medicine_groups.note: Count oral antidepressant tablets, capsules and liquids when the indication fits this criterion. Exclude topical doxepin and bupropion with naltrexone for weight management (Contrave). Generic packs that show the ingredient name with a company name count too. Bupropion is listed under Zyban, which is sold for quitting smoking.

medicine_groups.name: Benzodiazepines
medicine_groups.note: Generic packs that show the ingredient name with a company name count too. Count oral benzodiazepines during the joint course. Exclude one-off injections or rectal rescue doses for an acute event. If the purpose or duration is unclear, check it before confirming a finding.

rule_for_models: Report a finding when a Group A antidepressant for anxiety and a Group B benzodiazepine were both prescribed for one uninterrupted period longer than 28 days, including an ongoing as-needed prescription. Cite both medicines, the antidepressant indication and the evidence for the joint period. For fixed doses, use quantity and daily units to count each day of shared cover once. Alternatively use a course-specific account confirming the joint period. A stop separates courses. A joint period of 28 days or less or an antidepressant solely for another reason gives no finding. If both medicines appear but the antidepressant indication or joint duration remains uncertain, report a possible finding and ask for the missing detail.

needs_facts.what: Anxiety disorder (the reason for the antidepressant)
needs_facts.meets: The record identifies anxiety as a reason for this antidepressant during the joint course. An unknown indication supports only a possible finding. A different documented sole indication gives no finding.

options.words: Anxiety is a reason for this antidepressant course
This antidepressant course is solely for another reason

needs_facts.what: Duration of joint prescribing during this antidepressant and benzodiazepine course
needs_facts.meets: Ask only when both medicines appear and the supplies leave the length of joint prescribing uncertain. An account specific to this course can establish one period longer than 28 days, including ongoing as-needed prescribing. A series of separate short courses does not qualify. An uncertain duration leaves a possible finding.

options.words: Both prescriptions stayed current together for more than 28 days in one period
No single joint period was longer than 28 days

cannot_be_seen: Why each medicine was prescribed, how often the benzodiazepine is really taken, and benzodiazepines supplied by a hospital or another pharmacy.
ask_the_gp: Could we review the ongoing benefit of the antidepressant for anxiety, the reason for the benzodiazepine, and the benefits and risks of continuing them together?
